title: Grade 2 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #10

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Love? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Love.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Love with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hadith on Love has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on Love to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on swalah.
   D. Say Hadith on swalah has no place in daily life.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

4. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Iman? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Iman.
   B. Use Hadith on Iman to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on Iman has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Iman with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Milad un-Nabi? (1 mark)
   A. Say Milad un-Nabi has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Milad un-Nabi with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Milad un-Nabi.
   D. Use Milad un-Nabi to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   D. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Arabic alphabet? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Arabic alphabet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Arabic alphabet to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Arabic alphabet has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Arabic alphabet.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Dua before and after waking up.? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dua before and after waking up..
   B. Say Dua before and after waking up. has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Dua before and after waking up. to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Dua before and after waking up. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.
   C. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Dua before and after waking up. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Milad un-Nabi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Love with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. A — Apply the teaching of Hadith on swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. C — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. C — Telling the truth and keeping trust

5. D — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Iman with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. B — Apply the teaching of Milad un-Nabi with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. A — Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Apply the teaching of Arabic alphabet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. D — Apply the teaching of Dua before and after waking up. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A — Apply the teaching of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. D — Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Dua before and after waking up.; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Relationship; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Milad un-Nabi; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
